newsitem.title: USA: Alaska Airlines sees profitable year.
newsitem.headline: Alaska Airlines sees profitable year.

text.p: Alaska Air Group Chief Executive Officer John Kelly said Monday the airline is poised for a profitable year.
"Alaska Airlines is in its best competitive position in years," Kelly said at the company's annual shareholders meeting.

"At the same time, Horizon Air is adjusting to changes in its markets to improve its competitive position, the results of which we expect to see beginning in the third quarter," he said. "Ultimately, however, the level of our overall profitability will be affected by industry actions in the fourth quarter."
Alaska Air Group is the parent company of Alaska Airlines and Horizon Air Industries.
